name: Felfire Hill
summary: In eastern Ashenvale, Felfire Hill remains a blighted rise crawling with demons. Infernals struck it during the Third War, and its soil still burns with fel power. Horde guards hold the bridges leading to the hill, near their settlements.

sections.title: A Scar of the Burning Legion
sections.body: During the Third War, the Burning Legion sent flaming meteors across Kalimdor, carrying its fearsome infernals. Several struck this ridge in Ashenvale, burning away the ancient woodland and corrupting the earth. The Legion fell at Mount Hyjal, but demons that survived its defeat still prowl the scorched slopes. Fel energy saturates the land they haunt.

sections.title: Guarding the Crossings
sections.body: Felfire Hill lies southeast of Splintertree Post and southwest of the Warsong Lumber Camp, close to vital Horde operations. Demonic remnants threaten to spill into the surrounding forest. Horde forces have raised fortified barricades and guard towers at both bridges leading to the hill, keeping the creatures within their blighted haven.

faq.answer: During the Third War, infernals of the Burning Legion rained from the sky and struck Felfire Hill. Their impact and the fel contamination burned away the elven forest, leaving scarred rock and demonic energies that never dispersed.

faq.q: What creatures live on Felfire Hill?
faq.answer: Surviving demons and infernal constructs from the Legion's invasion during the Third War occupy Felfire Hill. They remain hostile to mortals who approach their corrupted ground.

faq.q: Why did the Horde fortify the bridges here?
aliases: why are orcs guarding felfire hill
faq.answer: Felfire Hill lies between Splintertree Post and the Warsong Lumber Camp. Horde commanders fortified both bridges to keep roaming demons from breaking out and overrunning nearby camps, supply convoys, and lumber operations.

faq.q: Is Felfire Hill connected to the night elves?
faq.answer: Felfire Hill lies menacingly northeast of the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, on ground once part of Ashenvale's sacred forest. Its spreading demonic taint and roaming fiends endanger the nearby slumbering grounds and surrounding wildlands.

angles.text: The Horde holds the fortified bridges around Felfire Hill to protect the transit road between Splintertree Post and the Warsong Lumber Camp from demonic raids.
Fel energy lingers on the ridge where the Legion's infernals landed, drawing the dangerous curiosity of those who practice dark magic.
